visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can a desperate scientist truly reverse time by siphoning innocence, or does harvesting dreams carry volatile consequences?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In a surrealist society, an aging scientist abducts local children to steal their dreams, desperate to halt his own decay in a strange, stylized world directed by Jean-Pierre Jeunet and Marc Caro.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Moody, suspenseful dark fantasy in French; measured pace requiring engaged attention for its surreal world.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Jeunet and Caro craft an inventive blend of fantasy, sci-fi, and adventure, turning a dark, fable-like premise into an atmospheric, thought-provoking European vision.
